color.note: Dark is the default theme and the fallback. Every text token's note names the grounds it is legible on; each pair holds 4.5:1 or better in both themes. reel, on-reel, reel-ink and reel-soft are the only tokens a personal accent may change.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App shell and page background: the near-black house lights. Behind the bottom navigation, the Clips feed and full-bleed posters.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Charcoal section ground: feeds, lists, the movie detail body below the backdrop.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on surface or bg: review cards, activity items, collection tiles, the swipe card body.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Things that float: confirmation modals, bottom sheets, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between list rows and around cards. Never the only boundary of a control; use line-strong for that.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control boundaries: input borders, secondary button outlines, unselected chip outlines. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, warm off-white in dark. Legible on bg, surface, surface-raised, surface-overlay and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata (year, runtime, timestamps, handles). Legible on bg, the three surfaces and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text only: placeholders, source attributions, 'updated 2 h ago'. Legible on bg, surface and surface-raised; not on surface-overlay.

tokens.name: reel
tokens.usage: The cinema-red accent as a FILL: primary buttons, the Interested vote, the active-tab bar, progress. One primary action per view. 3:1 against bg, surface and surface-raised. This is VieMo red, the default; a personal accent (AccentPicker) replaces it at runtime with a colour tuned to the same contrast.

tokens.name: on-reel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a reel fill (primary button labels). A personal accent may switch it to a near-black when the fill is light.

tokens.name: reel-ink
tokens.usage: The accent as TEXT or an icon: active nav label, links, selected chip label. Legible on bg, the three surfaces and reel-soft. Replaced along with reel by a personal accent.

tokens.name: reel-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected states: a selected filter chip, the current row in a list. Text on it is reel-ink or ink. Replaced along with reel by a personal accent.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Meaningful emphasis only: rating stars, the group's top pick, the agreement score. As text, legible on bg, the three surfaces and amber-soft. Never decoration.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind amber text: the 'Top pick' tag, the results headline band.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text on an amber fill (the rank-1 numeral badge).

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success and confirmation: 'Saved to watchlist', 'Everyone is ready'. Always with a check icon and a word. As text, legible on bg, the surfaces and positive-soft.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind positive text.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: failed requests, Delete. Vermilion, deliberately warmer than reel so an error never reads as the brand accent. Always with an alert icon and a word.

tokens.name: negative-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind negative text: error banners, the destructive modal's icon disc.

tokens.name: on-negative
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a negative fill (the Delete button in a confirmation modal): an alias of bg, so it inverts with the theme.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (an alias of ink): a solid 2px ring outside a 2px gap of bg. 3:1 or better on every surface and on reel.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Loading placeholder blocks, on bg or the surfaces.

tokens.name: skeleton-sheen
tokens.usage: The moving highlight across a skeleton (static when reduced motion is on).

tokens.name: poster-wine
tokens.usage: Fallback poster ground #1 when TMDB has no poster. Same in both themes: a poster is a printed object, not UI.

tokens.name: poster-slate
tokens.usage: Fallback poster ground #2.

tokens.name: poster-sepia
tokens.usage: Fallback poster ground #3.

tokens.name: poster-smoke
tokens.usage: Fallback poster ground #4.

tokens.name: poster-ink
tokens.usage: Title and year on a fallback poster ground, both themes.

families.sans: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Noto Sans", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
families.marquee: "Big Shoulders Display", "Arial Narrow", "Roboto Condensed", Impact, sans-serif

groups.name: Display
groups.note: The title-card voice. Instrument Serif has one weight; never set it below 24px or bold it.

styles.name: type-display-xl
styles.usage: One per screen at most: the Match result title, onboarding headline.

styles.name: type-display-lg
styles.usage: Tab page titles and the movie detail title.

styles.name: type-display-md
styles.usage: Collection titles, swipe-card film titles, empty-state headlines.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Schibsted Grotesk is variable 400–900; use 400, 600 and 700 only.

styles.name: type-heading-md
styles.usage: Film titles on cards, names in activity items, modal titles.

styles.name: type-body-lg
styles.sample: Quiet, patient and far funnier than the trailer lets on.
styles.usage: Long-form reading: the full review page, synopsis on movie detail.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: Maya rated it and added it to Friday night picks.
styles.usage: Default UI text, review previews, descriptions.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.usage: Metadata lines under titles, timestamps, helper text.

styles.name: type-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase overlines and source tags: SPOILERS, TMDB, FRIENDS. Two words at most.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: The ticket-stub voice: codes and measured numbers.

styles.name: type-data
styles.usage: Counts, scores and progress that a person compares: agreement score, session progress, rating values.

spacing.note: 4px base. Mobile pages use a space-4 side gutter.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its metadata line; chip-to-chip gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on compact cards; gap between poster and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page side gutter on mobile; standard card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Modal and bottom-sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a tab page.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty and error state vertical padding; above the first section on desktop.

radius.note: Softly rounded, never bubbly. Posters keep radius-md at every size so a grid of them reads as one shelf.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Provider badges, inputs, small poster thumbnails (under 56px wide).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Posters, film cards, buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Content cards, collection tiles, the swipe card, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals and the top corners of bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Filter chips, avatars, icon buttons, progress bars.

shadow.note: Two elevations, plus the focus ring. Dark theme leans on surface steps more than shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards at rest: film cards, review cards, collection tiles.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Anything floating over content: the swipe card in its stack, modals, toasts, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px bg gap, then 2px of solid focus. A box-shadow, so it follows the radius.

size.note: Fixed dimensions that the layout and Fitts's law depend on.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum touch target for anything tappable, icon buttons included.

tokens.name: tap-lg
tokens.usage: Primary match actions (Interested, Not interested) and the primary page action on mobile.

tokens.name: nav-height
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation bar height, before the safe-area inset.

tokens.name: avatar-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars in activity items, review cards and participant rows.

tokens.name: avatar-lg
tokens.usage: Avatar on a profile preview and the profile header.

tokens.name: poster-sm
tokens.usage: Poster thumbnails in activity items and review cards.

tokens.name: poster-md
tokens.usage: Poster width in horizontal film rails.

tokens.name: poster-lg
tokens.usage: Poster width in two-column grids and the movie detail header.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the reading column on tablet and desktop.

duration.note: Motion only clarifies a change of state. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration becomes 0ms except fades, which keep duration-fast.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Press states, chip toggles, icon swaps.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Card and sheet entrances, toast in and out.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: A swipe card leaving the stack, the results reveal.

tokens.name: duration-sheen
tokens.usage: One pass of the skeleton sheen.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Things arriving: sheets, toasts, cards.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Things moving between two resting places: reorder, tab indicator.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Bottom navigation and the desktop sidebar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
